# FocusStrategy

`Flare.Components.Combobox.FocusStrategy`

Which option to highlight when the dropdown opens.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `First` | `0` | Highlight the first enabled option. |
| `Last` | `1` | Highlight the last enabled option. |
| `KeepSelected` | `2` | Highlight the (first) selected option if any, otherwise the first enabled option. |
